fail.taskFileMissing: task file {file} not found — run init to resync
fail.blockedNeedsWorkPhase: status=blocked requires a work phase (got phase={phase})
fail.inProgressNoDonePhase: status=in-progress cannot use phase=done — set --status done first
fail.noActiveFolder: workspace {workspace} has no active tasks folder — run init <tasksDir>
fail.otherInProgress: task {id} is already in-progress — only one at a time
fail.usage: commands: init <dir> | next | show <id> | set <id> [--status S] [--phase P] [--force] | summary  (opt. --dir D)
warn.multiInProgress: warning: multiple in-progress on init, kept {keep}, blocked: {rest}
notice.askedQuestion: {id}: agent asked a question in chat — your reply is needed
followup.resume: Continue the task pipeline: read ~/.cursor/commands/task-pipeline.md and resume task {id} from phase {phase} (tasks folder: {tasksDir}).
followup.unblock: Continue the task pipeline: questions.md has answers (including auto from Recommendation) — run TP set {id} --status in-progress and resume from phase {phase} (tasks folder: {tasksDir}). Read ~/.cursor/commands/task-pipeline.md.
followup.nextTask: Continue the task pipeline without pausing: {prev}next task {id}. Run TP set {id} --status in-progress --phase plan and complete the full cycle (plan → fact → implement → check → commit) per ~/.cursor/commands/task-pipeline.md (tasks folder: {tasksDir}). Do not ask for a new chat or end with “continue?” — the stop-hook starts the next task.
